reviews.reviewText: MCQs mostly from Smart Workzone YT channel. TG, FA Graphs, and transition table ready karein. Most important: CFG.

* Finite Automata (DFA & NFA)
Definitions, state transitions, conversion from NFA to DFA, acceptance of strings

* Regular Expressions & Languages
Closure properties, equivalence with DFAs/NFAs, expression simplification

* Pumping Lemma for Regular Languages
Use for proof of non-regularity, identifying pumping length y

* Context-Free Grammars (CFG)
Types, derivation trees, left/right recursion removal, ambiguity

* Pushdown Automata (PDA)
Definition, transitions, acceptance by empty stack vs final state

* Conversion Techniques
DFA/NFA ↔️ Regular Expression, CFG ↔️ PDA

* Turing Machines Basics
Definition, tape, head movement, acceptance, decidability vs recognizability

* Closure Properties
